strings.gwipeConfirm:
⚠️ Full Google wipe:

• Kugwisya Play Store + Google Play services + Services Framework data.
• ⛔ Uyoozwa mumaakaunti aa Google (weelede kwaabikka alimwi). kakwiina kujatikizyigwa.
• Chibelesyo chilatalika lubo chilikke.

Uli masimpe na?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: ilalanga-langa keybox iiliwo lino kweendelana a Google's revocation list (CRL) mpawo isola nzila zyiingi mane yajana keybox iili kabotu, antoomwe akuyobola akutalisya alimwi Google milimu. Ibeleka aawo mpoigolela mpawo iyanda intaneti (1-3 maminiti).
strings.mdKbNet: • Bbokesi lyamakkii kuzwa kuneti: ulagwisya bbokesi lyamakkii kuzwa kubusena bwakuyobweda zintu (GitHub) mpawo ulibamba ku /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Uyanda intaneti mpawo utola maminiti aali 1-3. Chibelesegwa aawo smart fetch niyakachilwa naakuti aawo keybox niyakachinchwa amaanza.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP kulanga-langa: kulanga-langa zibeela zya Remote Key Provisioning ziliwo, kulanga-langa TEE bbazu lyakusinizya, mpawo kutondezya chiimo cha KmInstallKeybox tool. Tachichinchi chintu pe — kubona chiimo chachibelesyo.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine kulangisisya (kubala luzutu): kutondezya Widevine zitondezyo zyabulemu (L1/L3) kuzwa ku dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file presence, azintu zimwi zijatikizyidwe. Tachichinchi chintu pe.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Bbuku lya RKP lyakubambulula: lilabelesya sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh lyabbuku. Kubambulula twaambo twakuzumizya aawo nzila yakuzumizya yaalilwa. Kubalika kuli koonse kulatondezya mulongo uusalala wakuzwidilila/kwaalilwa.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Kubambulula RKP koonse: kweenda sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh koonse. Ulalanganya milandu miyumu mpawo ulatola chiindi chilamfu. Ikuzwidilila kulibonya kumamanino.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Kubweedezya GMS: kugwisya Play Store antoomwe a Google (GMS+GSF) data mpawo chitalisya lubo chibelesyo. Kusinizya biyo kwakuyumya moyo — kunyina nochijata zifwoto zyako naakuti ma fayela.
strings.mdCertify: • Kusinizya kwakusobana: kulangisisya RKP chiimo chakuzumizigwa chachibelesyo mpawo chibamba lubo zyintu zyakuzumizya kuti kakuli kuyandika. Tajati data yababelesi.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER kubambulula: kubambulula Google nzila zyakubelesya (SOTER) twaambo tujatikizya kusinizya zibelesyo. Chibelesyegwa kulizimwi zibelesyo zibelesya SOTER muciindi cha Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Amubelesye PIF: kubelesya nguzu zya sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh. Bikka chitondeezyo chamunwe chakasalwa (chakubusena/chakusumpuka) mpawo chibambulula pif.prop/pif.json ma fayela. Ikuzwidilila kulimvwisya kulibonya mubbuku lyamakani.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF kulanga: kutondezya chiimo cha injini yakabikkidwe, ma fayela aaminwe (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), antoomwe ama logi. Langa luzutu — tachichinchi chintu pe.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Kubweza Canary Engine mpya yakazwa kuchitila kuti ibeleke antoomwe azipepa zya RKP (Febuluwale 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Kulangisisya injini: kulangisisya TrickyStoreOSS chiimo (pid, logs), ma fayela aamubbokesi lyamakkii (aabeleka naa sikubelesya), chitondeezyo chamunwe wachibelesyo nchobeni naa chakubeja, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP makkii. Kutondezya buyo.
strings.hintKbSlots: Mulongo ooyu weendelezya zibeela zyobile zyamakkii: aakusaanguna (aasalala, taakwe naakazimwa) aabili (aakukwabilila). Eeyi tab itondezya kuti ncibeela nzi chibeleka, kuchincha nchoyanda, naakuti kusumpula chabili kuya kuchipati kuti kakumbilwa — antoomwe akubamba antoomwe alugwalo luzwide.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Kulangisisya kusyomeka: kulangisisya TEE kkii yakunjizya, laibbulali yakubikkwa mukati ka keystore2, chiimo chakugwisigwa (CRL), chikwabilizyo chamulongo wakukwabilila antoomwe a RKP chiimo. Kubala biyo — takuchinchi pe.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Kubelesya alimwi kakunyina ntenda:

• Mulongo wakukwabilila ulayakululwa kuzwa kuli pulogilamu yoonse iibikkidwe.
• Ibbazu lyakuzumizya-ROM lilabikkwa alimwi.
• Bbokesi lyamakkii libeleka lilabikkwa alimwi.
#000#milimo yakatalisyigwa alimwi.

Kunyina chakagwisigwa mpawo kkiibbokesi lyakusaanguna talijatikizyidwe pe.

Kuzumanana?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Zibeela zya Keybox: zitondezya chiimo chazibeela zyakusaanguna azyabili mpawo chichincha nzyoyanda aakati kazyo. Chakusanguna (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) lyoonse chikwabilidwe mpawo tachigwisyi pe. Kusumpula chabili kuya kuchipati kuyandika kusinizyigwa.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Sumpula busena bwabili kuya kubusena butaanzi:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml buba busena butaanzi.
• Chibaka chakusaanguna chiliwo lino chiyobolwa mbuli chiyobwedo katanachinchululwa.
• Taakwe chintu chigwisigwa — mulimo ulakonzya kubweedezegwa.
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Gwisya busena bwabili:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml ulagwisigwa.
• Busena butaanzi tabujatikizyigwi pe.

Kuzumanana?

• Ulangisisya kkii bbokesi liliwo lino kweendelana a Google mulongo wakugwisya (CRL).

strings.confirmRkpManual:
Kubamba alimwi RKP makkii:

• Taakwe data naa ma fayela aamubbokesi lyamakkii aagwisigwa.
• Amubweze luwaile musule.

Kuzumanana?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Kubambulula koonse:

• Kubambulula RKP + kutalika lubo Google milimu.
• Chibelesyo chitalika lubo (kunyina chazimwa).

strings.confirmGmsReset:
Talika alimwi Google milimu:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — talika alimwi luzutu.
• Taakwe chintu chakagwisigwa mpawo tokonzyi kuzwa pe.
• Chibelesyo chilatalika alimwi.
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Kusinikizya kubamba lubo (Red Magic):

• Kuzibelesyo zitabikkili maanu kubbokesi lyamakkii lyakavwundauka.
• Zilabeleka nikuba kuti makkii ali kabotu.
• Taakwe data yakagwisigwa.

Kuzumanana?
strings.confirmCertify:
Kusinikizya Play Store kusinizya:

• Kugwisya buyo chiyobwedo — akaunti yako taijatikizyidwe pe.
• Amutalike alimwi, mpawo jula chiyobwedo.

Kuzumanana?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER kubambulula:

• Kutalisya vendor.soter mulimo.
• Kugwisya SOTER data ya seva luzutu.

Kuzumanana?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Bikka chitondeezyo chamunwe (PIF):

• Usandula custom.pif.prop mpawo uchibike munzila ya injini.
• Kuyandika kutalika alimwi.

Kuzumanana?
strings.confirmCanary:
Bambulula minwe ya Canary:

• Kugwisya minwe ya Canary mpya kuzwa ku Google.
• Ibamba lukwabililo + italisya alimwi Google milimu (kunyina kugwisya).

⚠️ Uyandika intaneti (1-3 min). Yinkila kunembo?
